title: Automated Manual Transmission
text: Ideal automated manual transmission, 5 inputs, 3 outputs; {Control type} controls type Ideal, {Efficiency factors} sets the efficiency calculation, {Input shaft inertia, Jin} sets the inertia .01, {Input shaft damping, bin} sets the damping .001, {Initial input velocity, omegain_o} sets the angular velocity, {Gear number vector, G} sets the number of transmission speeds, {Efficiency torque breakpoints, Trq_bpts} sets the breakpoints, {Efficiency speed breakpoints, omega_bpts} sets the breakpoints, {Efficiency temperature breakpoints, Temp_bpts} sets the breakpoints, {Gear ratio vector, N} sets the ratio of input speed to output speed, {Transmission inertia vector, Jout} sets the gear rotational inertia, {Transmission damping vector, bout} sets the gear viscous damping coefficient, {Efficiency vector, eta} sets the gear efficiency, {Efficiency lookup table, eta_tbl} sets the gear efficiency array, {Initial output velocity, omegaout_o} sets the transmission, {Initial gear, G_o} sets the engaged gear, {Clutch pressure time constant, tauc} sets the time .02, {Synchronization time, ts} sets the time .25, {Clutch time, tc} sets the time .5, {Effective clutch radius, R} sets the radius .2, {Clutch force gain, K_c} sets the force 5e3, {Clutch static friction coefficient, mus} sets the coefficient, {Clutch kinematic friction coefficient, muk} sets the coefficient, {Start simulation with clutch locked} selects to initially lock clutch and {Start simulation with synchronizer locked} selects to initially lock synchronizer. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Control type
params.values: Specify control type Ideal integrated controller (default) | External control

params.name: Efficiency factors
params.values: Specify efficiency calculation Gear only (default) | Gear, input torque, input speed, and temperature

params.name: Gear number vector, G
params.values: Specify number of transmission speeds [-1, 0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5] (default) | vector

params.name: Gear ratio vector, N
params.values: Ratio of input speed to output speed [-4.47, 1, 4.47, 2.47, 1.47, 1, 0.8] (default) | vector

params.name: Start simulation with clutch locked
params.values: Select to initially lock clutch off (default) | on

params.name: Start simulation with synchronizer locked
params.values: Select to initially lock synchronizer off (default) | on
